detail.longDescription: Someone asked if anyone used FeedEcho with brrr. To make that work I added webhook pushes with custom JSON bodies, and then went ahead and added full-HTML email echoes, and real formatted bodies in Matrix rooms. All built on one new variable, {{ content_html }}: the article's actual markup, sanitized, links and formatting intact. https:// github.com/jcrabapple/feedecho /releases/tag/v1.67.0 # RSS # SelfHosted # OpenSource
